# File paths for source CSVs
source_files = [
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length6_76/training_0.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length6_76/training_1.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length6_76/training_2.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length6_76/training_3.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length6_76/training_4.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length6_76/training_5.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length6_76/training_6.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length6_76/training_7.csv",
]

# Read all source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the first index column
dfs = [pd.read_csv(f, index_col=0) for f in source_files]

# Concatenate all source tables (UNION)
df_all = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)

# Ensure columns are in the target schema order and types
# Target schema: ['created': string, 'screenname': string, 'followers': integer, 'favourites': integer, 'text': string]

# Convert columns to correct types
df_all['created'] = df_all['created'].astype(str)
df_all['screenname'] = df_all['screenname'].astype(str)
df_all['followers'] = pd.to_numeric(df_all['followers'], errors='coerce').fillna(0).astype(int)
df_all['favourites'] = pd.to_numeric(df_all['favourites'], errors='coerce').fillna(0).astype(int)
df_all['text'] = df_all['text'].astype(str)

# Assign to target table name
Target6_76 = df_all

# Write to the target CSV file without the index
Target6_76.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_76/target_multisource.csv", index=False)
